name: Altmühl
beschreibung: The Gasthof Altmühl is situated in a rural Tyrolean setting, surrounded by mountain scenery. The inn offers double rooms as well as a restaurant serving traditional Tyrolean cuisine. The property has been managed as a family business for several generations. The kitchen predominantly uses regional products from the surrounding area. Guests use the inn as a starting point for hiking in summer and ski touring in winter. A small wellness area with a sauna and steam bath is available. The Gasthof Altmühl is an authentic example of rural gastronomy and hospitality in Tyrol.
